subject: Pilot keepalive insurance request — connector handoff delay
messages:
From: Zoe Patel <zoe@cartspace.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff - connector handoff delay

Hi Maya / Ben / Marissa,

Quick update from our integration squad — we ran into an unexpected auth handshake failure while moving the CartSpace webhook connector from staging to their internal sandbox (it looks like our token exchange is dropping on retries). Engineering has a fix in progress but estimates are ~10 business days to complete the full validation and security review on our side. That pushes our demo window out beyond the pilot period you provisioned.

We really want to keep momentum with your team (the product execs are watching the upcoming demo slot), but without a short runway extension or a small keepalive credit we risk the pilot timing out and losing the exec slot.

Can Redwood provide a short pilot keepalive (2 weeks) or an equivalent promo credit while our SRE completes the handoff?

I can share logs and a short recording of the failure — attaching a sanitized log excerpt.

Attachment: cartspace-integration-log.txt (plain text)

Thanks,
Zoe Patel
Product Partnerships — CartSpace, Inc.
zoe@cartspace.ai

From: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Zoe Patel <zoe@cartspace.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff - connector handoff delay

Hi Zoe — thanks for the clear note and the log excerpt. Sorry to hear about the auth issue; I pulled in our Platform team for triage.

Ben / Marissa — quick ask: can we offer CartSpace a two-week pilot keepalive (no-cost promo credit covering inference usage) to preserve their demo slot while their engineers finish validation? This would be for the existing pilot deal DEAL-8892 and limited to the dev sandbox (no formal SLA change). If yes, I’ll confirm scope to Zoe and flag any usage caps.

Zoe — can you confirm the estimated completion date for the fix and whether you’ll need any support from Redwood (logs, temporary token rotation, test keys)? Will your security team need a shared audit artifact?

Thanks,
Maya
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Zoe Patel <zoe@cartspace.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot keepalive insurance request — connector handoff delay

Looping in a short business decision — CartSpace is a mid-funnel pilot with clear expansion signals. A two-week keepalive credit seems low-risk and strategically useful. Proposed guardrails:
- Duration: 14 days from 2027-03-18
- Credit cap: $1,200 (covers test traffic and live demo rehearsals)
- Scope: dev sandbox only; not eligible for production migration or dedicated capacity discounts

Marissa — do you have the green light from CS/Finance to issue a promotional credit at this cap? If you approve, I’ll draft the wording and update HubSpot (DEAL-8892) so the AE record reflects the make-good.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Zoe Patel <zoe@cartspace.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: Pilot keepalive credit for CartSpace (DEAL-8892)

Hi all — approved.

Summary of approval:
- Promo credit: $1,200 applied to the pilot account
- Effective window: 2027-03-18 to 2027-03-31 (14 days)
- Scope: dev sandbox only; excludes production endpoints and Dedicated reservations
- Conditions: CartSpace engineering to confirm completion of the connector validation and provide a brief handoff note to both Redwood SRE and the AE (ben@redwood.ai) once the fix is validated

I’ve attached the approval stub and updated the HubSpot record (see link). Ben / Karthik — please update DEAL-8892 and flag the credit so Finance can process the promotional adjustment.

Attachment: pilot-keepalive-approval.pdf (PDF)

Zoe — we’ll apply the credit on 2027-03-18 and I’ll confirm when it’s live. If you need temporary tokens rotated or additional logs pulled for the security review, reply with the specific request and we’ll coordinate with Platform.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
